title: refactor(contacts): rename total to totalCount in the list response
description: The other list endpoints we are adding return `totalCount`. Renames `total` to `totalCount` in `GET /v1/contacts` for consistency; the reference and the test follow.
rationale: `GET /v1/contacts` is a public, versioned endpoint: renaming a response field in place breaks every integration that reads `total`. It needs a new version, or both fields during a deprecation.
